lines.en: Hi, I'm Amy. I'm from China.
lines.zh: 你好，我是 Amy，我来自中国。

lines.en: I live near the MRT with my husband.
lines.zh: 我和老公住在 MRT 站附近。

lines.en: I work at a learning centre.
lines.zh: 我在一家补习中心工作。

lines.en: My English is not very good.
English is not easy.
I speak a little English.
Today I see my new neighbour.
She speaks very fast.
"Sorry, I don't understand. Slowly, please."
lines.zh: "不好意思，我听不懂。请说慢一点。"

lines.en: She can speak Chinese!
"Nice to meet you!"
I'm still learning English.

dialogue.title: 朋友的新家在哪里？
dialogue.setting: 星期五晚上，朋友 Lily 打电话给 Amy，请她周末去新家玩。

lines.speaker: Lily
lines.en: Hi Amy! How are you?

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Hi Lily! I'm fine, thank you.

lines.speaker: Lily
lines.en: I have a new home. Come this weekend!
lines.zh: 我搬新家了，这个周末来玩吧！

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Nice! What is your address?

lines.speaker: Lily
lines.en: It's near the MRT.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Sorry, I can't hear you. Can you say that again?
lines.zh: 不好意思，我听不到。可以再说一遍吗？

lines.speaker: Lily
lines.en: It's near the MRT.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Sorry, I don't understand. Can you write it down?
lines.zh: 不好意思，我不太明白。你可以写下来吗？

lines.speaker: Lily
lines.en: Sure!

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Thank you. Can you show me on the map?
lines.zh: 谢谢。你可以在地图上指给我看吗？

lines.speaker: Lily
lines.en: Sure! See you on the weekend.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: See you! Have a nice day!
